plans.idea: Keep the original's two-column composition squared up: a left column with the logo on top and the headline and subhead stacked below it on one left edge, and a large bottle filling the right half so it stands up against the big circle.

A centered poster that reads top to bottom: the logo centered at the top, a wide headline band with the subhead under it, then a large bottle centered in the lower half so there is no dead space below.

Product first: a big bottle centered across the upper half as the focal image, with a left-aligned headline and subhead block below it and the logo signing off in the bottom-right corner, the way a magazine cover would.
